rules: Every source-evidenced office, including historical codes, gets exactly one draft tier.
Geography and elected body classify; calendar labels never classify.
No extra mayor, county governor or Tallinn district council is invented.
Justin accepted this pack with named holds EE-G01 through EE-G09 still open. Clearing a research hold is not pack approval and is not done here.
No successor or code-equivalence inference from similar names.
notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-21 America/Edmonton with named holds EE-G01 through EE-G09 (status=approved, production_accepted=true). Holds remain open; not blockers for this landing. No hold was resolved.
